blocks.content: Suppose we have a graph with vertices, edges, and weights. Our goal is to make a minimum spanning tree.
Doing so with Kruskal's algorithm involves the following steps:

items: Start with the lowest-cost edge and add it to the minimum spanning tree.
Move to the next lowest-cost edge and add it to the minimum spanning tree.
However, if adding the edge forms a cycle, ignore that edge and move to the next lowest-cost edge.
The minimum spanning tree will be formed once you've scanned all the edges of the graph.
